transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um... I guess I'm just having some things going on at work. I'm a mechanic. Lately, I keep hearing this... man's voice. It comes from the garage vents, or sometimes right out from under the hood of the cars. 

It's as clear as somebody standing right next to me. He... he just keeps telling me not to trust my husband. Or that I shouldn't touch certain cars. So... that's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling unusually energetic lately?

Um... I guess. Sometimes. 

Once I get going, I just... I end up staying at the shop after closing. I'll start like three different repair jobs, or... try to plan a car club event. Reorganize the parts shelves. I just... I don't know, I still feel like I need to keep moving after all that. I just can't really stop.
When this happens, do you find that you need much less sleep than usual?

Yeah. I guess so. When it gets like that... for weeks, I might only sleep two or three hours a night. 

I'll just wake up way before dawn, and my head's already back in the garage. I don't know, it just... feels like trying to sleep any more is a waste of time.
Do you ever hear that man's voice when you're not in one of those high-energy periods?

Yeah. Um... even when things are quieter. 

Like... there were a few weeks recently where I was actually sleeping more. I wasn't making all those big plans or anything. But... I still heard him. In the garage. And... I still knew my husband and my boss were tracking me. So... yeah. It's still there.
Was there ever a time when you were hearing the man's voice while your mood felt normal?

Yeah... um, like I just said. Even when I felt normal... those quieter weeks where I was sleeping fine and not making all those plans. It didn't stop. I still heard him in the garage... and I still knew they were tracking me.
Have you had any recent seizures, head injury, or other neurological illness?
No. Nothing like that.
For at least one month, have you been hearing the man's voice or feeling tracked almost every day?

Yeah. Um... it's been a lot longer than a month. 

Probably... about ten months now. Just... almost every day.
Was there ever a period of at least two weeks when you were hearing the voice or felt tracked, but you were not depressed or unusually energized at all?

I... yeah, like I just said. There were a few weeks. It was quieter, I was actually sleeping more, not making all those huge plans. But... I still heard the voice out in the garage. And I still knew my husband and my boss were tracking me. So... yes.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
No. I haven't really felt like that.
During those high-energy periods, do other people tell you that you’re talking much more than usual or that they can’t interrupt you?

I guess. Um... sometimes when I try to explain my plans, or just... what's been happening, the words just pour out really fast. My husband tells me to slow down. The guys at the shop do too. But... it's just hard to stop. It feels almost impossible once I get going.
During those high-energy times, do you feel unusually powerful or especially important?

Um... I don't know about powerful. I just... I was sure I was the only one who really understood where the repair business was actually headed. Like... if everybody just listened to me, I could turn our little shop into the top EV place in the state. I just... knew I could do it.
During one of those high-energy periods, were you ever hospitalized because of it?
No. Um... I haven't been in a hospital.
During those high-energy periods, did they ever cause serious problems at work, at home, or with the police?

I mean... I guess. Just... some issues at the shop. I made a few mistakes, so they... they pulled me off the high-voltage EV work. They said they were worried I wasn't being safe. And... at home, things got pretty tense. We were fighting a lot, and it got bad enough that... my husband actually took me in for an emergency evaluation.
Have you ever had one of those high-energy periods last a full week or longer?
I don't know. Um... I wasn't really keeping track of the days.
Thinking of your longest high-energy period, did it last at least 7 days in a row?
I... I really couldn't tell you. Maybe. I just... I wasn't counting.
During those high-energy periods, did you feel unusually euphoric or excessively cheerful?

I guess... yeah. Sometimes I'd feel like... like I could fix every car in town. Just really up. But then... if my husband asked about the dishes, or if one of the other techs moved my socket set... I'd just blow up. Like they were trying to hold me back or something.
During those high-energy times, did you do things that were unusually risky or impulsive for you?
I don't... I don't think so. I mean, I mostly just stayed in the garage. I wasn't doing anything... crazy. Just working.
What is the longest stretch in a row that you went sleeping only two or three hours a night while feeling that revved up?

Weeks, I guess. Um... it would go on for weeks at a time. I'd only get maybe two or three hours. I'd just wake up before dawn and... my mind was already out in the garage. It just felt like trying to sleep any more was a waste of time.
During the past 10 months, have the times when you heard the voice or felt tracked while your mood was normal added up to most of that time?

Yeah, I guess so. I mean, even when I was quieter... you know, sleeping more, not trying to fix everything... it didn't stop. I still heard that voice in the garage. And I still knew they were tracking me. My husband and my boss. So... yeah, most of the time, I guess.
When your mood feels completely normal, do you still hear the man's voice?

Yeah... like I was just saying. Um... even if there's a quieter few weeks, and I'm actually sleeping... not making any huge plans. I still hear him. The voice in the garage. And... I still know my husband and my boss are tracking me. It doesn't go away.
